elements.element: If renewal is not automatic, renewal may occur only by mutual written agreement.
elements.evidence: The condition is demonstrably absent because both the Agreement and the Attachment expressly renew automatically; the automatic-renewal pathway therefore applies instead.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal term is twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The Agreement renews for 12 months, but the Attachment renews for six (6) months.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out by giving thirty (30) days’ written notice before renewal.
elements.evidence: The Agreement permits either Party, including Customer, to give 30 days’ notice, but the Attachment still requires 12 months’ written notice.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must provide Customer a renewal reminder sixty (60) days before renewal.
elements.evidence: Neither operative renewal provision requires Vendor to provide a 60-day renewal reminder.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent (3%).
elements.evidence: The clauses state that renewals continue on the same terms unless otherwise mutually agreed, but they contain no operative cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
Both the Agreement and the Attachment expressly provide for automatic renewal.

elements.element: Any required non-renewal notice window is no more than sixty (60) days.
elements.evidence: The Agreement’s 30-day window complies, but the Attachment retains a 12-month notice requirement, which exceeds 60 days.

elements.element: Any renewal price increase is capped at five percent (5%) or less.
elements.evidence: No operative provision imposes a 5% or lower price-increase cap.

result.reason: The redline corrects only the Agreement’s notice window. It leaves the parallel Attachment provision at 12 months and omits the Vendor reminder and price-increase cap, so it reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. The limited edit does not disturb unrelated commercial terms, but the failure to conform the parallel renewal provision materially undermines drafting quality.
